description: Scan attention temperature around one-example QKV-union boundary
proposal: Family: attention organization. Current retained frontier is 1,671 parameters at 99.000000%, exactly threshold (+0.000000 margin). There have been 17 prior macro-attempts in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0020 at 3,168 parameters/99.94%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0142, where four activation blends with QKV union 555/517 all scored 98.99% at 1,670. Hypothesis: that stable single failure reflects an attention-routing margin that a small temperature change can correct. The helper tests fixed logit multipliers 0.99, 1.01, 0.98, 1.02, 0.95, 1.05, 0.90, 1.10, alternating outward from one; each uses the identical QKV union and official runner. Stop on first acceptance because all share 1,670 parameters, after eight trials, on error, or after 12 wall-clock minutes. This is more informative than changing another model component because it directly calibrates the mechanism affected by the tie.
summary: Tested attention-temperature multipliers 0.99 and 1.01 with QKV union 555/517. The 0.99 candidate scored 98.89% and was discarded; 1.01 scored 99.04% at 1,670 parameters and was retained, moving the frontier down one parameter and restoring +0.04 points of margin. Outcomes: 1 accept, 1 scored nonqualification, 0 errors. Compute used two migrations/verifications over about 2m35s. Stop reason: acceptance left no eligible equal-count multiplier before the eight-trial/12-minute cap.
